lines.name: GNOMEY
lines.text: Seat card. Table nine, seat four. Phones off the felt. Welcome to Biscayne.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.subject: tommy
lines.text: New face. You're the kid with the free seat. Word gets around a small room, kid.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.subject: tommy
lines.text: Thirty-five years at these tables. Here's free advice: this room eats dreamers for breakfast.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Then I'll try to be lunch.

directions.text: the clatter of chips like rain on a tin roof, a floor call far off, a cash game laughing
